retrievalProfile.description: A centered portrait within a thin iridescent frame, flanked by out-of-focus flowers and featuring multiline geometric typography.
excludeWhen: dark or moody aesthetic is required
minimalist black and white photography is requested
industrial or brutalist design is needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A central square-framed portrait of a subject bathed in warm, hazy sunlight, surrounded by a thin prismatic border. The composition is layered with soft-focus flowers in the foreground and background, creating depth. Typography is integrated into the lower third using a distinct multiline, inline geometric style with a holographic texture.
coreVisualRelationships: Central subject framed by a thin iridescent square border
Foreground floral elements overlapping the outer margins
Strong directional lens flare from the left side
Typography anchored to the bottom center of the inner frame
coreInvariants: Thin iridescent or holographic square border framing the main subject

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered medium close-up portrait occupying the majority of the inner frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and the large multiline title at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the bright lens flare on the left, across the subject's face, down to the title, and out to the surrounding flowers.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Soft, hazy sky and field background provide breathing room around the subject.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm pastels (peach, soft yellow, pale blue sky).
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Muted sage green in the outer border area.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Iridescent/holographic spectrum in the border and text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High key with low contrast and soft, desaturated tones except for the vibrant floral accents.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid harsh blacks or high-contrast primary colors.

letterConstructionRules: Characters are composed of multiple parallel thin lines (inline style)
Geometric construction with circular curves and straight stems
Holographic or prismatic texture applied to the fill
characterSpecificRedesigns: The letter 'A' may be represented as a simple triangle or delta shape
The letter 'M' uses sharp, parallel diagonal lines
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Pair the complex multiline display font with a clean, wide-tracked geometric sans-serif for secondary information.

candidateDirections.reason: Directly matches the multiline geometric aesthetic.
Provides a similar parallel line construction.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a sun-drenched portrait of a person in a flower field with a hazy sky, featuring a strong lens flare from the left and out-of-focus flowers in the foreground. Surround the image with a muted sage green border and a thin holographic square frame.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply the title in a large, multiline geometric inline font at the bottom center with a prismatic texture. Place secondary text at the top center in a wide-tracked geometric sans-serif.

verificationChecks: Is the typography multiline and geometric?
Is there a visible lens flare effect?

adjustableVariables: Number of lines in the multiline font
mustRedesign: Avoid using specific artist names or copyrighted logos
Ensure the holographic texture is a generic spectrum gradient

mustAchieve: Consistent iridescent texture across border and text

postGenerationChecks: Check for thin iridescent frame alignment
Ensure lens flare does not obscure facial features
Confirm floral elements appear in both foreground and background
recipe.reuseFormula: Portrait + Iridescent Square Frame + Multiline Geometric Type + Sun Flare + Floral Overlays
